comments.body: Use main as Docker Image tag, as it’s always a build of the main branch.
Keep the tag latest around for now, but use it to tag the latest stable release.

The image is built by the following pipeline in step:

https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo/blob/main/.github/workflows/build.yml#L174

I wonder if we should update the build-and-push-to-dockerhub.sh script to not allow you to provide either “latest” or no tag. Currently you can and it will push up the image allowing hub.docker.com to add the default latest.
PR with Jared’s requested tag check https://github.com/fcrepo-exts/fcrepo-docker/pull/22
Moved latest/empty tag test to start of build script at Jared’s request from last weeks tech meeting

renderedFields.description:
With https://github.com/fcrepo-exts/fcrepo-docker/pull/17 the naming scheme for the docker images has changed.

Docker image built the the pipeline of https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo/ should be tagged with the following tags:

  • fcrepo/fcrepo:MAJOR-tomcat9 (e.g. 6-tomcat9)
  • fcrepo/fcrepo:MAJOR.MINOR-tomcat9 (e.g. 6.4-tomcat9)
  • fcrepo/fcrepo:MAJOR.MINOR.BUGFIX-tomcat9 (e.g. 6.4.1-tomcat9)
